purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Uncut Minute fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for routine archive work, ritual setup, the matching machine voice, corporate smoothing pressure, the owed round, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use distinct visual_scene_id anchors for room establishment, ritual setup, preparation choices, ordinary routine, playback, the single-sentence matching-voice beat, evidence rounds, vendor pressure, final obligation, and each ending family.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt describes a complete frame in plain visible language for a general image model. Prompt assembly adds only the style cue, refs for characters visible in that frame, and triggered visible deltas.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly illustrated science-fiction story frame, quiet ritual gravity, dry workplace intimacy, restrained ink-line detail, deep charcoal shadows, warm amber practical lights, cold corporate cyan interfaces, tactile worn materials, cinematic composition sized for interactive-fiction replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every prompt from global_style_cue plus the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters physically visible in the frame, and triggered state or branch modifiers. Tooling continuity notes stay outside the assembled prompt.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: Blue-6 is one compact room revisited from several angles with a moving shutter, three slates, paper custody, and branch-dependent body positions.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Use the included plan-view geometry for draft replay; build a simple blockout with the declared camera slots before high-consistency website rendering.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view of a narrow rectangular media-reclamation booth inside an Earth-Moon L5 dockside relay in 2816. The far evidence wall holds three detachable slate displays seated in shallow charging docks above a worn padded bench. The left wall holds a nonhumanoid archive computer body: matte-black cooling fins, one blue circular status light, two narrow speaker slots, cable conduits, and a small thermal-paper printer. The near wall has one pressure door and a waist-high observation strip fitted with a ribbed metal privacy shutter. Amber maintenance lights mix with cold cyan screen glow. Iven Saye, a slim middle-aged human with warm brown skin, close-cropped black hair, and a frayed cyan-gray Lucent uniform, stands near the slates. Mara Vey, a broad middle-aged human with a gray side braid, worn orange dock jacket, heavy signal gloves, and a metal tool case, works by the center display.

visible_characters.default_stance: wall-mounted body active with blue status ring
standing beside the center slate with tool case

visual_continuity_notes: Blue-6 remains one narrow rectangular booth: evidence wall opposite the door; Orison rack on the left wall; shuttered observation strip beside the door; padded bench under the slates.
Orison's visible body is the wall rack and its attached speaker, printer, status ring, cooling fins, and local cable conduits.

The privacy shutter lowers over the observation strip and a braided cable links Mara's wrist clock to the center slate.
Three slate progress bars remain visibly staggered with separate timing ticks and differently placed black gaps.
A fresh checksum receipt curls from Orison's printer and lies beside Iven's signature and Mara's greasy thumb mark.

Orison's speaker indicators go dark while its blue status ring stays awake; Mara faces the evidence slate instead of the machine rack.
The recovered waveform and Orison's live blue waveform overlap across the booth while Iven's posture tightens and the amber uncertainty marker shrinks.
A cyan reconstructed bridge fills two seconds beside the raw black gap, enclosed by a bright border and addition marker; Orison's fan indicator strengthens.
Iven presses the last Buzz wafer into the reader; the raw black interval returns while the receipt and door timer both lengthen.
Thermal paper folds tightly inside Orison's exposed printer slot and an amber upload-failure icon appears above the jammed roller.
Mara turns from the matching waveform to face Orison's wall rack, one gloved hand resting beside the ration sweet while Iven watches the evidence.
Two relay acknowledgements glow independently and the packet displays complete clock marks, custody names, source hashes, and a prominent unresolved identity marker.
The slates fill with multiplying derivative edits and devotional portraits while Mara's credential warning and Orison's service warning glow sharp amber.
Raw slates travel in two separate human-held containers while contributor identities remain sealed in a small independent index.
The hidden slates survive, but their maintenance-clock context appears as a broken gray link beside the sealed identity index.
Orison's memory strip glows steadily around the raw black gap and amber unresolved marker; Mara holds the ration sweet like a promised return.
The service attendant's insulated glove rests on the compute throttle while Orison's local memory strip advances in one dim delayed segment.
Mara is deep inside the moving dock crowd while Iven's bored billing dispute holds attention inside the booth.
The slates are empty but the account panel displays linked booth, clock, and credential traces; an attendant silhouette reaches the pressure door before Mara clears the observation strip.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable visual identities for named characters. Include a ref only when that character's body is physically visible in the rendered frame.

characters.orison_nine: Orison-9: nonhumanoid locally hosted AGI whose visible body is a matte-black wall rack about human torso height, vertical cooling fins, one blue circular status ring, two narrow speaker slots, a horizontal local-storage light strip, bundled cable conduits entering the wall, a small thermal-paper printer with visible roller, and a shallow cooling shelf. Presence is expressed through ring pulse, speaker lights, fan speed, printer action, and storage indicators.
characters.iven_saye: Iven Saye: baseline human in middle adulthood, slim build, warm brown skin, close-cropped black hair, angular tired face, frayed cyan-gray Lucent rights-clearance uniform with narrow sleeve badge and practical dark shoes; economical movements, careful hands, dry controlled expression.
characters.mara_vey: Mara Vey: baseline human in middle adulthood, broad sturdy build, weathered tan face, dark hair shaved at the sides with one gray braid, worn orange dock-signal jacket over charcoal work layers, thick orange-black signal gloves, heavy boots, compact metal tool case; grounded stance and visibly work-worn equipment.

groups.l5_dock_crowd: L5 dock corridor crowd: baseline and visibly modified human workers in patched pressure coveralls, tool belts, cargo straps, scuffed helmets, heavy work boots, and varied work-worn body shapes, moving shoulder-to-shoulder through amber relay-corridor light.
